zh: **用量面板里热力格的日期提示不再把面板撑出横向滚动条**：提示胶囊按自己当时的宽度决定贴向格子的哪一边，靠近两端的格子不再把它带出面板边缘，悬停时面板本身也不再横向滚动。
en: **A heat cell's day tip no longer pushes the usage panel into a horizontal scrollbar**: the pill lines up with the side its own width needs, so a cell near either end keeps it inside the panel and hovering no longer scrolls the panel sideways.
